content: Ekei Mahsen Audapan en Solomon
Iet kan mahsen audapan kan en Solomon: Pwutak loalokong men kin kaparanda seme; a me pweipwei men kin kansensuwedihala ine.
Pai me ke ahneki sang ni tiahk en mwersuwed sohte pahn katepehiong uhk, ahpw wiewia mehlel pahn doarehla omw mour.
KAUN-O sohte pahn ketin mweidohng aramas mwahu kan en duhpekla, ahpw e sohte pahn ketin mweidohng aramas suwed kan me re anahne.
Pohnkahke pahn kahrehiong uhk semwehmwe, ahpw doadoahk laud pahn kahrehiong uhk kepwehpwe.
Aramas emen me mie eh lamalam kin dolung wahnsahpw ni ahnsawi, ahpw me kanamenek memeir ni ahnsoun dolung wahnsapw.
Aramas mwahu men pahn ale kupwuramwahu. A en aramas suwed men eh lokaia kin karirihala eikek en nan kapehde.
Katamanpen aramas mwahu kin wiahla mehn kapai, ahpw aramas suwed pahn mwadangete manoknokla.
Aramas me mie eh lamalam kin perenki ale kaweid mwahu. Aramas me kin wia lokaiahn pweipwei pahn ohla.
Aramas mehlel kin saledek sang apwal, ahpw me likamw akan pahn lohdi.
Aramas me kin ekihla me mehlel kin kahrehda kahpwal, a me kin kasalehda ni sansal kin kameleileidi wasa.
Lokaiahn aramas mwahu men iei poahsoan en mour, ahpw lokaiahn aramas suwed men kin ekihla eikek en nan kapehde.
Kailok kin kahrehda kahpwal, ahpw limpoak kin mahkohng sapwung koaros.
Mahsen en me kupwurokong kan kin wehwe mwahu, ahpw aramas pweipwei kan anahne ale kalokepen arail sapwung.
Me kupwurokong kan kin nantihong kalaudehla ar kupwurokong, ahpw ni me pweipwei kan ar kin koasoi, kahpwal kerendohr.
Reken kepwe kin sinsile me kepwehpwe kan; paisuwed kin kauwehla me semwehmwe kan.
Katingpen wiewia mwahu, iei mour, ahpw dihp kin kalaudehlahte dihp.
Aramas me kin rong kopwungparail pahn mourla, ahpw me kin kahmahmki ar sapwung milahr nan keper.
Aramas me kin ekihla eh kailok, iei ih aramas likamw men. Aramas me kin wisik lokaia likamw iei ih pweipwei men.
Me kin lokaia tohto kin kalaudehla dipe. Ma ke me loalokong, eri, ke pahn nennenla.
Lokaiahn aramas mwahu men rasehng silper mwakelekel; en aramas suwed men eh lamalam me sohte katepe.
Lokaiahn aramas mwahu kin wia kamwahu ong aramas tohto, ahpw ke kak pein kemehkinuhkala omw pweipwei.
Iei kupwuramwahu en KAUN-O me kahrehda omw kepwehpwe. Doadoahk laud sohte kak en kakepwehpwehiukala.
Tiahk en pweipwei me perenki wiahda me sapwung. Aramas loalokong kin nsenamwahuki kupwurokong.
Aramas pwung kan kin alehdi dahme re anahne, ahpw me suwed kan alehdi dahme re kin keieu masak.
Ni ahnsoun melimel, me suwed kan pahn ipirekla, ahpw me lelepek kan pahn saledek sang apwal ahnsou koaros.
Dehr mweidohng aramas pohnkahke men en wiahiong uhk mehkot, e pahn duwehte pinike me ngihmw kan kin rerikihda de ediniei nan pwoaren mesomw.
Lemmwiki KAUN-O, ke ahpw pahn mour werei. Aramas suwed kan kin mour mwotomwot.
Koapworopwor en aramas mwahu kan kin kahrehiong irail peren, ahpw sohte mehkot me aramas suwed kan pahn kasikasik.
KAUN-O kin ketin sinsile aramas lelepek kan, ahpw kin ketin kamwomwala irail kan me kin wiahda me sapwung.
Aramas pwung kan pahn saledek sang apwal ahnsou koaros, ahpw me suwed kan sohte pahn mourla nan sahpwo.
Aramas pwung kan kin wia koasoi en kupwurokong, ahpw lowen me kin wia lokaia suwed pahn katoktokdi.
Aramas pwung kan ese lokaia kadek, ahpw me suwed kan kin wia lokaia kansensuwed ahnsou koaros.
